payload.title: Gate A (require_regression_anchor) runs only over changes committed inside the nightly cycle's own window, while executor deliveries call the matrix at change_validated without the flag, so a delivered fix PR with no test or fixture in its diff passes every in-lane gate
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation_matrix_gate.py:561-587 (Gate A fires only with require_regression_anchor True in enforced mode; its docstring calls it the Tier-1 'every autonomous fix leaves a test' floor)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:3384-3410 (the only caller passing True iterates changes committed since the cycle's own start)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_ledger.py:581-615 (the window query returns only changes recorded at or after the cycle's start)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_delivery.py:719-739 (the delivery records change_validated through that emit, so the flag is never set for an executor delivery)
payload.rule_violated: Plan 031 Gate A as written in validation_matrix_gate.py:581-582: 'Tier-1 make it impossible' for an autonomous fix to reach change_validated without a durable test; a Tier-1 claim that holds on one lane only is a Tier-4 claim.
payload.notes: An executor delivery is committed by the separate executor job, after the cycle that minted its request, so no cycle window contains it, and its change_validated is written without the flag. A fix whose diff contains no test or fixture path is validated, pushed and opened as a PR, and the merge side receives no proof that a test exists for the change. Plan row: F3.5 (first slice, audit top fix 2). Close condition: Pass require_regression_anchor=True through change_ledger.emit_change_validated from implementation_delivery._record_change_validated so a delivery with no test or fixture path is refused with a named stage before the PR opens. Test: deliver_implementation for a change whose affected files contain no test or fixture path is refused regression_anchor_required and opens no PR (red today). Plan row: F3.5 (first slice). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
